text: dsh-theme-shelter 是面向 DSH 网页客户端的沉浸式天气氛围插件。它通过客户端主题注入在界面叠加动画与控制面板，并由主机端提供配套音频。用户可以切换雨、雪、炉火或关闭场景，调整强度、调色板、夜间模式、声音和雨景闪电。适合想为 DSH 工作界面增加环境氛围的用户；代码未声明需要 API 密钥或外部账号。

dsh-theme-shelter adds weather ambience to the DSH web client. Its injected theme displays animated rain, snow, or hearth scenes with a control panel for intensity, palette, sound, night mode, and rain lightning. The host serves bundled audio. No API key or external account is declared.
想给 DSH 网页界面加上雨雪或炉火动画。
DSH 工作时能不能显示天气氛围并播放环境声音？
Can I add animated rain, snow, or fire ambience to my DSH web workspace?
dsh-theme-shelter 的功能「天气场景与控制面板」：在 DSH 网页界面显示雨、雪或炉火动画，并提供场景、强度、调色板、声音、夜间模式和闪电开关。用户通过界面角落的按钮打开面板并调整效果。

dsh-theme-shelter README · What it is：Shelter is a thin layer of weather over the DeepSeek Harness web GUI. Rain leaves beads on the glass; snow drifts slowly outside; a fire glows under the composer.

It changes nothing about how DSH works — only the air you sit in while working. The entry point is a 28 px button in the bottom-right corner; the rest of the time it just rains, quietly.

dsh-theme-shelter README · Scenes：| Scene | What you see | Palette |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Rain** | Streaks that each fall at their own speed, slant with the wind, and splash where they land | Cool blue-grey, deep navy shadows |
| **Snow** | Two kinds of crystal drifting through one wind field, over a bank that grows as it snows | Colder and whiter, icy-blue accents |
| **Fire** | A warm pulse from below, rising embers, sparks, slow smoke | Warm neutrals, amber accents |
dsh-theme-shelter README · Scenes：Semantic colors (error red, success green, warning amber) are untouched in every scene.

dsh-theme-shelter README · Install：Requires DeepSeek Harness (desktop or web).

```powershell
cd "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\desktop"
pnpm add "C:\path\to\dsh-theme-shelter"
```

Then append `dsh-theme-shelter` to `dsh.profile.bundles` in the profile `package.json`, and reload the window (<kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>R</kbd>) or restart DSH.

Manual alternative — add to `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: theme-shelter
      name: dsh-theme-shelter
```

dsh-theme-shelter README · Usage：Click the small button in the bottom-right corner:

| Control | Effect |
| --- | --- |
| Scene | rain / snow / fire / off |
| Intensity | light / medium / heavy |
| Palette | theme colors on or off — the animation runs either way |
| Lightning | rain only: bolt, flash, thunder |
| Sound | rain and fire recorded, snow wind generated |
| Night | dark palette plus a moonlight wash |

dsh-theme-shelter README · Usage：**Lightning.** A strike draws a branched bolt across the sky, flashes the pane, then bangs. The delay encodes distance — 0.3–0.9 s when close, 1.5–2.8 s when far — and a close strike leaves a cracked pane for 5–9 s. Strikes land every 2–9 s, denser at intensity 3.

**Sound.** Browsers refuse audio until the page has seen a click or a keypress, so the first sound arrives after your first interaction.

Settings live in `localStorage["dsh-theme-shelter/v2"]` and survive reloads.

dsh-theme-shelter README · Usage：**First run.** On a fresh install a small bubble appears above that button — “点这里切换天气” — and disappears for good once you click it, open the panel, or after twelve seconds. If you miss it, the button is always in the bottom-right corner: 28 px, with a cloud, umbrella, snowflake or flame depending on the scene.

Console API:

dsh-theme-shelter README · Usage：```js
__dshWeather.setScene("fire")     // rain · snow · fire · none
__dshWeather.setIntensity(2)      // 1 light / 2 medium / 3 heavy
__dshWeather.setPalette(false)    // animation only, default colors
__dshWeather.setSound(true)

dsh-theme-shelter README · Audio：Rain and fire are recordings (about 6.7 MB). The host half serves them read-only at `/dsh-theme-shelter/audio/*` with `Range` (206), `HEAD`, a one-year immutable cache, and a 403 for cross-origin `Origin`.

Snow has no recording, because real snowfall is nearly silent: it is a looped brown-noise bed through a lowpass that breathes over roughly fifteen seconds, held at a whisper (0.04 / 0.07 / 0.11 against rain’s 0.18 / 0.30 / 0.42). It needs no asset and starts before any file has loaded.

dsh-theme-shelter README · How it works：- **Colors** — `ctx.theme.overrideTokens()` overrides 47 `--dsw-alias-*` tokens: surfaces, text, borders, code blocks, scrollbars. Button fills, brand colors, links and focus rings are deliberately left alone.
- **Rain** — every drop carries a diameter and a distance. Terminal velocity is `v = 9.2·√(d/3)` (0.5 mm ≈ 2.2 m/s, 3 mm ≈ 8.5 m/s); screen speed and width scale by `1/z`; the streak is `speed × 6 ms exposure`, clamped to 7–70 px; the angle is `atan(wind / speed)`, so drizzle leans further than heavy rain, over a slow gust envelope. Streaks taper from a thin tail to a bright head and are baked into sprites (5 width × 4 length buckets) so each drop costs one `drawImage`.
- **Splashes** — a landing drop throws 5–9 droplets at 16% of its impact speed (scaled by distance) under 900 px/s² of gravity, plus a crown ring, plus a near-vertical Worthington jet for close, fat drops. Each droplet is an oblate ellipse flattened along its own velocity — and it oscillates while flying, so the flattening breathes; sub-0.5 mm droplets stay round.
- **Snow** — crystals with habits. Two thirds are dendrite aggregates (2.5–7.5 mm, falling at 0.55–1.0 m/s,

dsh-theme-shelter README · Development：`preview/preview.html` is a standalone harness: it fakes the module loader and `ctx.theme`, so you can open it directly to see all three scenes, night mode and the panel.

The profile links this package with `link:`, so editing `client/client.js` only needs a DSH restart.
